title: Krampus
about: A family Christmas goes so badly that a young boy's lost spirit summons the dark shadow of St. Nicholas.
cue: Serve the gingerbread when the gingerbread men come to life.

    StartersOmi's pretzels with obatzda cheese dipSoft baked pretzels with a creamy camembert and paprika dipHow to make it500g pizza dough2 L water60g bicarbonate of soda1 egg, beaten1 tsp sea salt flakes200g ripe camembert50g butter, soft50g cream cheese2 tbsp ginger beer1 tsp sweet paprika1/2 tsp caraway seeds1 red onion, finely diced1 jar cornichonsRoll the dough into ropes and twist into pretzels.Dip each in simmering water with the bicarb briefly.Brush with egg, sprinkle with sea salt and bake at 220°C.Mash the camembert with the butter, cream cheese, ginger beer, paprika, caraway and onion.Serve the pretzels warm with the dip and cornichons.Aunt Dorothy's French onion dipSlow-cooked onion dip with sour creamHow to make it3 brown onions, thinly sliced30g butter1 tbsp vegetable oil1 tsp Worcestershire sauce250g sour cream100g cream cheese1 small bunch chives, chopped3 tbsp crispy fried shallots200g kettle chipsSlowly cook the onions in the butter and oil over low heat until jammy and deep brown.Add the Worcestershire and a splash of water, scrape the pan, then cool.Mix with the sour cream, cream cheese, most of the chives and salt.Chill the dip.Top with crispy shallots and chives and serve with kettle chips.MainsChristmas Eve lasagneBeef mince and tomato lasagne layered with white sauceHow to make it600g beef mince700g passata1 box lasagne sheets40g butter40g plain flour500ml full cream milk150g mozzarella, gratedBrown the mince, add the passata and simmer.Make a white sauce from the butter, flour and milk.Layer the meat sauce, lasagne sheets and white sauce in a baking dish and top with mozzarella.Bake at 180°C until golden and bubbling.Engel house fennel and apple saladShaved fennel, apple, rocket and parmesan. Fresh before the storm hitsHow to make it2 fennel bulbs2 green apples100g rocket40g parmesan1 lemon1 tsp Dijon mustard3 tbsp olive oilWhisk the juice of the lemon with the mustard, olive oil and salt.Shave the fennel and apples thin and toss straight into the dressing so the apple stays white.Toss through the rocket and shave the parmesan over the top.SweetsGingerbread men with icing grinsSpiced ginger cookies with piped icing teeth and red eyesHow to make it100g butter100g golden syrup80g dark brown sugar300g plain flour1 tsp bicarbonate of soda2 tsp ground ginger1 tsp ground cinnamon1/4 tsp chilli powder1 egg150g icing sugar1 bottle red food colouringMelt the butter with the golden syrup and sugar. Mix in the flour, bicarb, spices and egg to a soft dough.Chill the dough.Roll out and cut gingerbread men.Bake at 180°C, then cool.Mix the icing sugar with water and pipe jagged teeth. Add red eyes with a little tinted icing.DrinksOmi's apple glühweinHot red grape and apple juice with cinnamon, clove and star aniseHow to make it750ml red grape juice750ml cloudy apple juice1 black tea bag1 tbsp brown sugar2 cinnamon sticks6 cloves2 star anises2 oranges, slicedPour the grape juice and apple juice into a saucepan with the tea bag, sugar, spices and half the orange slices.Heat gently without letting it simmer, lifting out the tea bag after 5 minutes.Ladle into mugs with an orange slice each.
